aspect: Deposits, consumables and the caesarean surcharge
description: Registration, gloves, drugs, blood, and a substantially higher price for surgical delivery - payable before or during, in a system where the decision to operate is the emergency.
energy_note: The operation that saves you has a price on the door.

aspect: Which is why home delivery is chosen by people who know the risk
description: The choice is not ignorance. It is a household with N4,000 and a facility that requires N60,000, making a rational decision with bad options.

aspect: And detention for unpaid bills happens
description: Women and newborns held in facilities until bills are settled is a documented practice in several low-income health systems, and it deters the next woman from attending at all.
energy_note: Kept in the ward until somebody pays for you.

description: She delivered on the Friday. The bill is NGN 210,000 and her husband has raised NGN 130,000. On the Tuesday she and the baby are still on the ward, not being treated, because the ward will not discharge until it is settled. She is occupying a bed that the next woman needs.
energy_note: Four extra days in hospital, for want of the balance.
